Patient: Dakota Demoson   DOB: 05-16-51   MRN: D4237748
*** SYNTHETIC RECORD - NOT A REAL PATIENT ***
Author: M. Nakamura, DO
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Date of service: 12-28-22. Patient presents to the emergency department.

HPI: Chief complaint: periumbilical abdominal pain with nausea for approximately 12 hours.

Past medical history: hyperlipidemia, seasonal allergies. Past surgical history:
tonsillectomy in childhood. Family history: father with hypertension. Social history:
never smoker, drinks alcohol socially, works in an office setting.

Review of systems: Constitutional negative for weight change. HEENT negative.
Cardiovascular negative for chest pain or palpitations. Respiratory negative for cough.
Genitourinary negative for dysuria. Skin negative for rash. Neurologic negative for focal
weakness. All other systems reviewed and negative except as noted.

Vitals: BP 122/76, HR 90, RR 18, SpO2 98% on room air, Temp 36.9 C.

Abdominal exam: mild tenderness to deep palpation in the periumbilical region. No rebound.
No guarding documented.

Labs: WBC 17.1 x10^3/uL (H). Lipase within normal limits.

Impression: abdominal pain, likely gastritis.

Discharged home with omeprazole 20 mg by mouth daily.

Return precautions given for worsening pain, fever or vomiting.

I personally evaluated the patient and reviewed the available records. Documentation
completed with the assistance of templated text and reviewed for accuracy.
